I use an integration test rig in lighthouse for this test. <@412614104222531604> block proposed by a node without EL (builder mandatory on fulu) Could we merge https://github.com/ethpandaops/ethereum-package/pull/1358? (CI is red) The main issue however on Fulu (won't be the case with gloas) is builders tend not to send any bid if no tx. No bid ==> no getPayload => No payload => no block at all With gloas a beacon block without a payload will be fine
